alt: Diagram of the PS5 and Xbox menu paths to read free storage space, with the 212 GB advice.

data.title: Check free space on PS5 and Xbox
data.body: PS5: Settings > Storage. Xbox: Xbox button > Profile & system > Settings > System > Storage devices. Keep at least 212 GB free (PlayStation's advice).
data.tip: Xbox path is general. Check the names on your console.
